svg.text: JS44127: IG for ST (model-predicted; label PRESENT); first correct pair of ST with ACCEPTED beat detection
18 detected R peaks (automatic; extractor rate state ACCEPTED); |IG| share: QRS-centred 50% (duration 29%), RR regions 48% (65%), outside 2% (6%)
Detected beats: dark = QRS-centred window (+-80 ms), triangle = automatic R-peak, number = RR interval (ms)
time (s); background colour = signed single-class IG (red raises the logit, blue lowers it), same scale in all leads
Lead-summed IG per 20-sample block: positive (red, up) / negative (blue, down); grey = QRS-centred windows
Regions surround AUTOMATIC detections from the Step 4.3 extractor (not expert-validated); IG describes model sensitivity, not a physiological cause.
